new_categories.label: hold_cleanliness_readiness
new_categories.memory: Dry-cargo hold cleanliness readiness is a cargo-space preparation service-state distinct from hatch/access, ventilation, bilge/drainage and liquid-cargo tank washing.

new_categories.label: residue_contamination_confidence
new_categories.memory: Residue or contamination confidence can be represented non-specifically without retaining contaminant identity, quantity, acceptance criterion or cargo-compatibility decision.

new_categories.label: hold_scope_readiness
new_categories.memory: Cleanliness assurance can be localized to an affected hold, surface zone or bounded cargo-space scope without retaining exact inspection grids or cleaning coverage.

new_categories.label: inspection_verification_confidence
new_categories.memory: Inspection/verification confidence is distinct from physical cleanliness readiness and can degrade even when cleaning work has been reported complete.

new_categories.label: cleaning_support_dependency_confidence
new_categories.memory: Cleaning-support readiness can be represented separately from delivered hold-cleanliness state without retaining cleaning agents, washwater methods, equipment settings or work sequences.

new_categories.label: dryness_surface_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-numeric dryness or surface-condition confidence state can be distinct from residue/contamination confidence without retaining moisture values, coating details or acceptance limits.

new_categories.label: independent_check_confidence
new_categories.memory: Independent inspection or cross-check confidence is distinct from shipboard self-assessment and from the physical hold condition itself.

new_categories.label: recontamination_recurrence_confidence
new_categories.memory: Post-cleaning recontamination or recurrence confidence can degrade after an initially satisfactory preparation state without implying a specific source or mechanism.

new_categories.label: cargo_acceptance_not_cleanliness_state_equivalence
new_categories.memory: Cargo acceptance, loading permission or claims confidence are downstream outcomes and are not equivalent to hold-cleanliness, residue, dryness or inspection state.

new_categories.label: hold_cleanliness_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: The service can move through prepared, degraded, restricted, under-cleaning, under-verification and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction or hold-out-of-service scope can attach separately to cleanliness, residue/contamination confidence, dryness/surface condition, inspection confidence or cleaning-support dependency.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Cargo rejection, loading delay, contamination concern, claims activity, port rework or schedule effects do not prove a residue source, cleaning-support defect, inspection failure or hold-scope root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_hold_cleanliness_restoration
new_categories.memory: Physical cleaning completion, surface/dryness recovery, reinspection, independent verification, cargo acceptance and hold release can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: liquid_tank_washing_vs_dry_hold_preparation
useful_refinements.memory: P098 liquid-cargo tank washing/cleaning service does not duplicate dry-cargo hold cleanliness, residue and preparation assurance.

useful_refinements.label: hatch_access_vs_hold_cleanliness
useful_refinements.memory: P086 hatch-cover/access readiness affects cargo-space access and ingress exposure but does not establish cleanliness, residue or inspection readiness.

useful_refinements.label: ventilation_vs_cleanliness_preparation
useful_refinements.memory: P089 cargo-space ventilation can support drying or atmosphere exchange but does not establish hold-cleanliness, residue or contamination readiness.

useful_refinements.label: hold_bilge_drainage_vs_cleanliness
useful_refinements.memory: P108 hold-bilge/water-ingress detection and drainage assurance can affect preparation conditions but does not establish delivered cleanliness or inspection confidence.

duplicates.label: generic_service_support_verification_lifecycle
duplicates.memory: Generic service/support degradation, verification and restoration mechanics repeat prior service-state families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_downstream_separation
duplicates.memory: Generic scope localization, downstream-effect separation and verified-restoration mechanics are already campaign-wide.

exact cleaning agents, washwater methods, equipment settings, inspection grids, tests or work sequences
exact coating/surface details, moisture values, drying criteria or current configuration
named hold-cleaning contractors, surveyors, ports, yards, cargo disputes, incidents or current-readiness facts
negative_space: exact hold cleanliness/residue/contamination acceptance criteria, contaminant identities, coating details, moisture values, cargo-compatibility decisions and current configuration
exact cleaning agents, washwater methods, cleaning equipment settings, inspection grids, test methods, work sequences and troubleshooting procedures
named cleaning contractors, surveyors, ports, yards, cargo interests, incidents, contamination disputes, deficiency findings and current readiness
private/regional hold-cleaning, inspection and support lineages plus non-English predecessor terminology
stop_reason: The bounded structural questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact cleanliness criteria, contaminants, cleaning agents, washwater methods, cargo-compatibility decisions, inspection tests, providers, incidents or procedures that are deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive dry-cargo hold cleanliness/residue/contamination preparation orientation and source-discovery output; not cleaning, inspection, cargo-acceptance or compatibility guidance and not proof of any exact criterion, contaminant, cleaning method, inspection result, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
